set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols mpls interface [parameter1.explanation: Enables the MPLS protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols ldp router-id [parameter1].explanation: Configure the LDP protocol router ID.

set protocols l2circuit neighbor [parame.explanation: Configures a Layer 2 Circuit (L2Circuit) neighbor with the specified IP address (`[parameter1]`) for point-to-point pseudowire connectivity.

interface [parameter2].explanation: This command configures a Layer 2 Circuit (L2Circuit) by specifying a neighbor device (`parameter1`) and associating it with a local interface (`parameter2`) for pseudowire establishment.

encapsulation-type [parameter2].explanation: The command `encapsulation-type [parameter2]` sets the encapsulation method for a specific interface or protocol, where `[parameter2]` specifies the encapsulation type (e.g., `ethernet`, `ppp`).

set protocols l2vpn vpls vpls-id [parame.explanation: Configures the VPLS instance VPLS ID.

parameters.name: vpls-id
parameters.explanation: The only identifier for the VPLS example.

set protocols l2vpn vpls neighbor [param.explanation: The command configures a VPLS neighbor by specifying the remote PE device's IP address (`[parameter1]`) for Layer 2 VPN connectivity.

signaling protocol [parameter2].explanation: The command `signaling protocol [parameter2]` configures the signaling protocol used for a specific service or interface, with `[parameter2]` specifying the protocol type.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

encapsulation [parameter3].explanation: Configure the envelope type of the interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

family [parameter3].explanation: Enables the MPLS protocol on the interface.

set protocols ldp interface [parameter1].explanation: Enables the LDP protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols ospf area [parameter1].explanation: This command configures an OSPF area in Junos OS, where `[parameter1]` specifies the area ID, enabling OSPF routing within the defined area.

interface [parameter2].explanation: Configure interfaces in the OSPF area.
